records.title: FedDA-HSI: Federated Class-Aware Framework for Hyperspectral Image Classification With Diffusion Augmentation
records.abstractSummary: Local federated diffusion generation creates synthetic HSI without raw-data sharing; class-aware augmentation fills missing or underrepresented classes and mitigates non-IID client data; abstract reports improved heterogeneous-condition classification.

records.title: SPECIAL: Zero-Shot Hyperspectral Image Classification With CLIP
records.abstractSummary: Spectral interpolation converts HSI to RGB for CLIP pseudo-label generation; multi-scale confidence fusion and noisy-label learning refine labels with spectral information; abstract reports zero-shot evaluation on three HSI benchmarks.
